passages.text:
[opaque block] Google Vault - Re: The next guest speaker for SEC...
Re: The next guest speaker for SEC...
[contact omitted] Diana Parzik Wednesday, December 1, 2021 at 3:45:08 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Lorri Anne Meils
Cc: [contact omitted] Maurice Kent, [contact omitted] Daniel Stolkowski, [contact omitted] Lisa Poggiali
Hi-
I'm not tracking a similar event recently, but it sounds quite interesting. The GEC has a digital disinformation index (DDI)
for USG only, and we've had some discussions about that tool, but it's a little different than the GDI. I'll be in and out
during the holidays, but I would be happy to participate, please let me know how I can be of assistance.
Thankyou!
Diana
On Wed, Dec 1, 2021 at 1:46 PM Lorri Anne Meils <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Maurice,
Sorry i haven't had a chance to follow up. I am copying Diana Parzik in on this thread as she has the perfect
background for this discussion and may be a great fit!
Thanks!
Lorri
Lorri Anne Meils
Human Rights, Technology and Authoritarianism Advisor
Center of Excellence for Democracy, Human Rights and Governance
[opaque block] E: [contact omitted]
[opaque block]
On Mon, Nov 29, 2021 at 1:23 PM Maurice Kent <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Lorri Anne, Lisa,
I would like to introduce you to Daniel in SEC, whose team covers a number of different aspects of security issues
facing USAID staff. They're looking to invite a speaker (details below) for their regular series on the basics of
disinformation, how it affects our programs, etc. I figured that the DRG Center would likely be a great potential co-
host, as well as a source of confirmation re: whether we've had this sort of presentation before, recently.
Any insight you can provide for SEC would be welcome.
Thanks!
. Forwarded message ----
From: Daniel Stolkowski <[contact omitted]>
Date: Tue, Nov 23, 2021 at 1:24 PM
Subject: The next guest speaker for SEC...
To: Maurice Kent <[contact omitted]>
Hi Maurice,
Running this by you as an FYI.
[opaque block] 1/2

[opaque block] Google Vault - Re: The next guest speaker for SEC...
As you may know, the SEC Guest Speaker Series aims to help USAID better understand security-related issues
impacting our work. Our speakers so far this year have been Peter Lord, VP of Strategic Initiatives [contact omitted] Oracle;
Jonathan Hillman from the Reconnecting Asia Project at CSIS; and we also hosted the authors of this paper from
RAND.
For our next talk, I would like to invite Dr. Danny Rogers. I have known him since the days I worked for the U.S. Army
(INSCOM) and he worked at the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory. Danny is a physicist, an
author, and an expert in cryptography, cybercrime, disinformation, and security. He currently teaches in the
Cybercrime and Global Security Masters Program at New York University's Center for Global Affairs and is a Security
Fellow at the Truman Project on National Security. He currently works at the Global Disinformation Index. I've seen
some of his webinars, and I think he's a good web-speaker. (That's him speaking in the video.) He recently also
testified on the subject at the U.S. Capital.
l've reached out to him, and he is available to do a custom webinar for USAID some time in mid December. (I'm
thinking Dec 22, actually.)
Still not 100% confirmed, but I wanted to let you know. Feel free to pass along any thoughts.
Thanks,
Daniel
Maurice Kent (He/Him)
Program Coordinator - USAID Digital APEX
USAID Bureau for Development, Democracy and Innovation
[contact omitted]
[contact omitted]
[opaque block]
Diana J. Parzik
Counter-Disinformation Coordinator
Democracy Resiliency and Innovation (DRI)
Development, Democracy, and Innovation Bureau (DDI)
U.S. Agency for International Development - USAID
[opaque block]
[opaque block] 2/2
